status: designer-approved colour set; concept precedes implementation; review in game
colour_space: sRGB hex bytes; convert only as required by renderer texture pipeline
combination_policy: All 4 clothing sets x 4 hair colours approved for either body. Keep tee/patch/trouser values as a coordinated tuple, choose hair independently. No random RGB or arbitrary cross-pairing of cloth regions.
application: Guest body palette texture/material variant only, shared cached resources by (clothingId,hairId). Do not modulate whole body, material albedo, scene root or props. No source mesh/UV/GLB modifications. All poses of a guest use same cosmetic choice.
excluded: skin-tone variation, eye/mouth recolouring, hairstyle/geometry edits, new outfits or patterns, staff/performer recolouring, props, customization UI, gameplay traits or save fields
